description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal migrate field plugins, including methods for altering migration processes, retrieving field types, and mapping widget and formatter configurations.

classes.name: FieldPluginBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for all field plugins in Drupal's migration system, including migration alteration and type mapping methods.

methods.name: alterFieldMigration
methods.description: Modifies the migration process for a specific field.

methods.name: alterFieldInstanceMigration
methods.description: Placeholder for altering field instance migration; default does nothing.

methods.name: alterFieldWidgetMigration
methods.description: Alters the widget migration process by mapping source to destination widgets.

methods.name: getFieldFormatterType
methods.description: Retrieves the formatter type from a source row.

methods.name: getFieldFormatterMap
methods.description: Returns an empty array; meant to be overridden for formatter mappings.

methods.name: getFieldWidgetType
methods.description: Retrieves the widget type from a source row.

methods.name: getFieldWidgetMap
methods.description: Provides default widget mapping using plugin ID.

methods.name: alterFieldFormatterMigration
methods.description: Modifies the migration process for field formatters, removing 'd6_' or 'd7_' prefixes from plugin IDs.

methods.name: defineValueProcessPipeline
methods.description: Defines a processing pipeline for a field's value during migration.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Determines the field type, considering possible type mappings.
